evidence.reason: The negative test writes a stale manifest digest of "2"*64 and mocks the refreshed download with digest "3"*64 over data b"unexpected". Since b"unexpected" hashes to neither digest, an implementation that incorrectly accepts a downloaded image matching the stale manifest (as well as the refreshed one) still raises here and passes the test. The test therefore does not enforce its stated requirement. Using vm.sha256_bytes(b"unexpected") for the stale manifest while keeping "3"*64 as the refreshed digest would distinguish rejection under the refreshed manifest from acceptance under the stale one. The test is unchanged at the current tip.
